notes.title: Patch Notes Oct. 14th, 2023
notes.content:
Lot of bug fixes the past few days and an update to the in-game News & Patch Notes to pull from Steam. This patch note will include the past few days where we were putting it in a stickied post. Moving forward all updates will be posted through the Events & Announcements via Steam!

Oct 14th, 2023 Update:

- Spawn orbs should now hide properly for the round they are linked to.
- Population now restores properly when a unit dies.
- Properly displaying objective data when near objective location for SM and human.
- Logs placed at bridge will resize properly now.
-Players joining any vote phase should now get the proper vote countdowns.
- Changed main menu to streamline towards finding a server. There were too many buttons without proper logic setup.
- The electric box and witch timers now properly appear and count down for joined clients.
- Can no longer fire a weapon when dead.
- Spectators should no longer see player detail names as "text block".
- Time before countdown to vote for Spawn master increased to allow for players taking time when server restarts.
- Clients can no longer see spawn locations on ground for spawn orbs.
- Doors not opening at start of round to let players out.
- Multiple players dying to become spawn master but only 1 being chosen, instead of just 1 player becoming spawn master
- Humans have clothing again.
- Listen hosts who are the SM have orbs and units working properly.
- Unit spawning no longer crashes game.
- Hanging bodies actually fall when trap is activated.
- Added a few more traps in open areas.
- Fixed some sound attenuation on certain traps.
- Maps now do full restart on match end.
- Can no longer reset timer on defendable objects.
- New text pops up near objective sites for survivor and spawn master detailing what to do.
- Cannot press e on witch to repeatedly make her scream.
- Pressing E on witch against after starting countdown doesn't restart countdown.
- Removed fake yellow trap display orbs that were left in.
- Removed pair of shoes that weren't moving with skeleton.
- Connected clients receive message in chat box when new player joins
- Impact sounds setup for most metal and wood objects.
- Bullets from crates no longer falling through floor when spawned.
- Updated in-game patch notes to pull from Steam's Events & Announcements.
- Progress made on session status and scoreboard ( tab key ).
- Weapon gunfire is playing on client, tested.
- Reloading now works properly for weapons.
- AR15 auto fire now works.
- Dropping guns stores weapon in gun (on the pickup) and now restores properly
- Reloading will now only happen if its the server calling.
- No longer tick updating with RPC calls to refresh ammo display on survivor.
- Lengthened damage casters on butcher and reaper.
- Increased butcher health from 100 to 300.
- Fixed not being able to do propane mission.
- Reaper does damage when leaping at someone and hitting an enemy.

notes.title: 09/10/2023 Patch notes
notes.content:
These are the notes for the patch from 09/10/2023 

- Truck trap fixed.
- Several holes around Deadwoods fixed.
- Added more cleanup boxes and box colliders around Deadwoods.
- Fixed Deadwoods objectives flow and verified working. Win/lose for both teams.
- Fixed a few non-replicated items such as forklift sequence doors.
- Fixed finale witch hitbox.
- Adjusted timers for objectives.
- Set some objects to static and adjusted collisions for performance on Deadwoods.
- Fixed human character and FPS side to now work.

Please note, we are also hoping to have another patch done and uploaded tonight with more improvement.
